verdict.rationale: Cross-app file access is a fair question for a terminal and SFTP client that runs on iOS and Android, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a desktop dual-pane SFTP view of local and remote files, plus import of the ~/.ssh folder and CSV files. Nothing documents reaching into other apps' sandboxes, such as a Files-app or document-provider integration or access to another app's repositories, so these adjacent features earn no credit.
